info.title: Mortgage delinquency by county and state (CFPB Mortgage Performance Trends), monthly from 2008: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Mortgage delinquency by county and state (CFPB Mortgage Performance Trends), monthly from 2008: The share of mortgages 90 or more days delinquent and 30 to 89 days delinquent, from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's Mortgage Performance Trends, for the nation, every state and DC and each county the CFPB publishes (counties with at least 1,000 mortgages in its sample): the latest month, the same month a year earlier, the change in percentage points, the highest and lowest 90-day share since January 2008 and each year's December values. Percents only, as the CFPB publishes them.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
